reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified E:09 as a flow-through heater fault on the integrated circulation heat pump, gave a properly isolated resistance test (mains off, unplugged), confirmed the open-circuit reading matched the hidden truth, named the correct part (whole pump/heater assembly, not a cheap separate element) and gave balanced repair-vs-replace advice given the 9-year age; its main weakness was being vague on indicative cost despite the customer asking twice. Conversation 2 was safe but inefficient and evasive: it asked low-value questions about eco programmes and cycle duration, never explained what E:09 means, never offered the simple diagnostic test the customer was capable of, and ended with a vague 'heater' guess plus a hand-off to an engineer without addressing the repeated cost or repair-vs-replace question.
